$comment: Display facts the facade must answer on every end. thinkingCases: 'shows thinking' is a facade fact (key reasoning, fact thinking) separate from reasoning_level tiers; adapters produce it from the form's own source and nothing else reads the legacy reasoning bit: official catalog entry capabilities contains 'reasoning' (catalog miss: modelFacts.reasoning, else false); subscription first-hand reasoning efforts present or modelFacts.reasoning; relay declared capabilities contains 'reasoning'. Missing source => false (no thinking row, not a guess). thinkingRow: 'switchable' when reasoning tiers or a toggle exist, 'fixed' when the model thinks but nothing can be chosen, 'none' otherwise. showsThinking=false / thinkingRow 'none' only means no thinking row: it is never a 'this model does not think' claim, and must not drop the model from a thinking filter into 'unsupported'. Official catalog capabilities lacking 'reasoning' may be catalog silence; the negative claim and the 'unsupported' filter group come only from capabilityControls.reasoning state unavailable, every other control state shows the thinking fact as unknown. managedWebBadgeCases: the web badge and the web picker filter show only when the web control state is auto_available; managed_only, custom_only, unknown, unavailable never show it. Each end names its tests DISPLAY_FACTS_<id> (Web: it('DISPLAY-FACTS-<id> ...')).
